headline: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
context: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.

sources.name: NPR
